title: DAST
brief: **Ticket:** confirm a vulnerability on the running app, not just in code.
theory:
## DAST
Attacks the **running** app to confirm real exploitability. Tool: **OWASP ZAP**. Finds runtime/config issues SAST can't; needs the app up.

investigation.intro: Attack the live app and confirm reflected XSS.
steps:
```bash
cd /workspaces/examto/appsec-lab
python3 -m venv .venv 2>/dev/null; . .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; pip install -q -r requirements.txt
python3 run_server.py
```
The script is reflected unescaped - a confirmed live vuln. Name it (3 letters) for the task.

capture.task: **Name the confirmed vuln.** Reflecting a <script> payload live is which OWASP flaw? (3 letters)
